Along Maine’s rocky coast, lobstering is not only a job, but a way of life passed down through generations. Join me as we cruise and fish with sixth-generation lobsterman Erik, meet his buddies, and get an inside look at the traditions, challenges, and culture that still define this old-school Maine community.
